name: RenownUserStats
description: Per-app metrics reported about one Renown user: the current value of each (app, metric)

operations.name: SET_USER_DID
operations.description: Binds the document to the user it describes. Set once; repeating the same DID is a no-op.

errors.name: InvalidUserDidError
errors.description: The user DID is not a did:pkh:eip155 or did:key DID

errors.name: UserDidImmutableError
errors.description: The document already belongs to another user DID

operations.name: SET_STAT
operations.description: Reports the current value of one metric for one app. Upserts by (appDid, metric); a report older than the stored one is ignored.
operations.schema:
input SetStatInput {
  id: OID!
  appDid: String!
  metric: String!
  value: Float!
  updatedAt: DateTime!
}

errors.name: UserDidNotSetError
errors.description: SET_USER_DID must run before any stat is reported

errors.name: InvalidAppDidError
errors.description: The app DID is not a did:key DID

errors.name: DuplicateStatIdError
errors.description: A new stat reused the id of an existing one

errors.name: TooManyMetricsError
errors.description: The app already reports the maximum number of metrics for this user
